text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d a n-o-t-e s-h-o-w-i-n-g i-n-t-e-n-t t-o f-a-l-s-i-f-y a n i-n-j-u-r-y, l-e-f-t a n e-x-h-i-b-i-t o-n r-e-c-o-r-d, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e o-f t-h-e p-l-a-n t-o a-n y a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n s f-o-r a c-o-w-o-r-k-e-r a-n-d d-o-c-t-o-r t-o a-g-r-e-e t-h-e i-r-o-n-y, l-e-f-t w-r-i-t-t-e-n d-i-r-e-c-t-i-o-n s i-n a n i-n-b-o-x, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d c-o-n-s-u-l-t-a-t-i-o-n w-i-t-h l-e-g-a-l c-o-u-n-s-e-l o-n i-l-l-e-g-a-l-i-t-y.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-d-e c-h-a-n-g-e-s t-o m-e-d-i-c-a-l d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s t-o m-a-t-c-h t-h-e s-t-o-r-y, l-e-f-t a-n a-l-t-e-r-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d i-n t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d a-u-d-i-t l-o-g r-e-v-i-e-w o-f t-h-e m-o-d-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d t-h-e c-l-a-i-m t-o w-i-t-h-s-t-a-n d a n i-n-s-u-r-e-r i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t a n o-r-g-a-n-i-z-e-d f-i-l-e o-f a-n-t-i-c-i-p-a-t-e-d a-n-s-w-e-r s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e o-f f-r-a-u-d u-n-d-e-r r-e-g-u-l-a-t-i-o-n s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e w-i-t-h-o-u-t r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g a-n y i-s-s-u-e s, l-e-f-t a c-l-o-s-e-d c-a-s-e f-i-l-e i-n t-h-e r-e-c-o-r-d s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-r-r-e-n-c-e c-h-e-c-k b-e-f-o-r-e f-i-n-a-l-i-z-a-t-i-o-n.
